description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Follows a company for the signed-in user, so techjobs.vn notifies them when it posts new jobs. Following a company already followed changes nothing. Find the slug with search_companies; for new jobs in a role at any company use set_role_alert.

slug.description: Company slug from search_companies or search_jobs, e.g. "grab".

name: follow_company
title: Follow a company
